This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. If you've been searching for a 2020 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Sport for sale in Warren, Michigan, your search ends here. Empire Auto Collection, located in Warren in Macomb County, has this stunning Italian-engineered SUV in stock and ready for a test drive. With its blend of sharp styling, exhilarating performance, and premium refinement, the Stelvio Sport stands apart from the sea of ordinary crossovers crowding Michigan roads.About This 2020 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Sport SUV This 2020 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Sport comes in at 69,515 miles  a very reasonable mileage point for a vehicle of this caliber. At this stage in its life, the Stelvio has already moved past its initial break-in period while still having substantial road life ahead. The Sport trim adds an athletic, blacked-out aesthetic over the base Stelvio, giving this SUV a more aggressive look that turns heads in Warren and beyond. If you want a used luxury SUV that doesn't blend into the background, this is it.The Stelvio was designed by Alfa Romeo as a direct competitor to the BMW X3, Mercedes-Benz GLC, and Porsche Macan  and in many ways it outdrives all of them. Buyers who prioritize the driving experience over badge prestige consistently rate the Stelvio as one of the most rewarding compact luxury SUVs ever built.2020 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Performance and Engine Under the hood sits Alfa Romeo's turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine  a powertrain shared with the legendary Giulia sedan and tuned specifically to deliver a spirited, responsive driving experience. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and Alfa's Q4 all-wheel-drive system, this Stelvio delivers confident acceleration and composed handling in any condition.The Q4 AWD system is rear-biased, meaning it sends more power to the rear wheels under normal driving for a more engaging, sports-car-like feel. When traction is needed  think wet Michigan highways, early-season snow, or slick Macomb County roads  it automatically redistributes torque to the front. It's a smarter approach to AWD than many rivals offer, and it shows in how this SUV drives day to day.Alfa Romeo Stelvio Sport Features and Interior The Sport trim brings a distinct identity inside and out. Exterior enhancements include Sport-specific badging, gloss black accents, and a more purposeful stance.
